meta.title: A round without a currency setup shows the rupee symbol; a multi-currency round shows each vendor its own currency
gaps: No setup recipe creates two pricing rounds with different currency configurations, including base INR and allowed USD.
No operation sets vendor currency preferences or creates the required multi-currency configuration.
read_round has no currency mode, currency symbol, precision, base currency, or vendor-preference read-back fields.
The invalid configuration case cannot be expressed because no operation saves a round currency setup and verifies the resulting refusal.
